description: A poster printed on heavy, scorch-edged stock, the same weight as the one it was torn from. Cyd sits sideways in an open cockpit hatch with his boots hanging out over nothing, helmet off and tucked under one arm, flight jacket unzipped, entirely unhurried while the skyline behind him goes up floor by floor and the rotors are still turning over his head. He is not looking at the fire. He is looking at whoever is running toward the aircraft, with the patient expression of a man who has already decided to wait the extra ten seconds. CYD — HE PUTS IT DOWN WHERE YOU ARE, NOT WHERE IT'S SAFE. Stencilled beneath in charter-service type: "no manifest, no questions, no refunds, and he has never once left early." The starboard wing runs off the right-hand edge of the frame, cut clean by the tear, as though it went on somewhere. A real length of copper wire, worried bright by passing thumbs, is threaded through two punched holes along that torn edge.
name: hero poster: CYD, THE ONE WHO COMES BACK
